items.headline: Texas State and Utah State meet in Pac-12 action
items.description: Utah State (2-4) at Texas State (3-3), Oct. 24 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Burgess, Jackson help Texas State rush for school-record 503 yards in 66-27 romp over Colorado State
items.description: — Torrance Burgess Jr. rushed for career highs of 224 yards and four touchdowns, Brad Jackson threw a touchdown pass and ran for career highs of 181 yards and three scores and Texas State steamrolled Colorado State 66-27 on Thursday night.

items.headline: Colorado State visits Texas State in Pac-12 matchup
items.description: Colorado State (2-3) at Texas State (2-3), Oct. 15 at 8 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Dennis Franchione, coach at Texas A&M, Alabama, TCU, dies at 75
items.description: Dennis Franchione, whose 40-year college football coaching career included stops at Texas A&M, Alabama and TCU, has died at the age of 75.

items.headline: Hawkins' 96-yard KOR for TD, Cooper's pick-6 help San Diego State beat Texas State 31-29
items.description: — Jaylon Hawkins returned the opening kickoff of the second half for a touchdown, Cameron Cooper had a 32-yard pick-6, and short-handed San Diego State beat Texas State 31-29 on Saturday night in the inaugural Pac-12 Conference game for both teams.
